title: BTO Flat Buyers Delaying Collection of Keys to Sell Existing Property
what_it_is: BTO Flat Buyers Delaying Collection of Keys to Sell Existing Property

sections.label: Cancelled new flat bookings
sections.summary: No increasing trend was observed; 45 buyers cancelled new flat bookings, paid forfeiture and stayed in existing flats, mainly due to financial or personal reasons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Over this period, we have not observed an increasing trend in the proportion of such cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The vast majority were able to sell their existing flats and complete the new flat purchase.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: However, a minority, or 45 buyers in particular, eventually opted to cancel their new flat bookings, pay the forfeiture and continue living in their existing flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The main reasons for their cancellations include changes to the buyers' overall financial circumstances or they no longer wished to proceed with the new flat purchase for their own personal reasons.

sections.label: Deferred key collection appeals
sections.summary: Two percent of invited buyers appealed to defer key collection, and 45 of them cancelled bookings; HDB grants extensions and can waive forfeiture for financial hardship.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Two percent of the people we invited to collect their keys appealed to defer their key collection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And of that number who appealed to defer their key collection, 45 eventually opted to cancel their new flat bookings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the assistance we can provide to such people who are in difficulties, on a case-by-case basis, in fact, as I have mentioned, HDB already exercises flexibility and grants time extension.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Even for that minority who chose not to, if there are financial hardships, we can look at the particular case at hand and waive the forfeiture that they have to pay.
